questions.question: At which forum did Piyush Goyal launch the ‘Bharat Cleantech Manufacturing Platform,’ aimed at boosting solar, wind, hydrogen, and battery sectors, and positioning India as a global leader in clean energy manufacturing?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Bharat Climate Forum 2025**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister **Piyush Goyal** launched the **'Bharat Cleantech Manufacturing Platform'** during the **Bharat Climate Forum 2025** in New Delhi to enhance India's cleantech value chains in **solar, wind, hydrogen, and battery storage sectors**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Goyal highlighted that **subsidies and Product Linked Incentives (PLIs)** could harm the **long-term growth** and development of the clean energy sector.
 
• The platform aims to foster **collaboration, innovation, and financing**, facilitating the exchange of ideas, technologies, and resources among Indian firms.
 
• Goyal reiterated India's goal of achieving **500 Gigawatt of clean energy capacity by 2030**, with **200 Gigawatts already installed**, exceeding targets set under the **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)** submitted in 2015.
 
• India has achieved its 2022 renewable energy target **8 years ahead of schedule**, showcasing its commitment to addressing climate change.
 
• Goyal also acknowledged **Gujarat** as a pioneer in adopting solar power, setting an example for other states.

questions.question: What is the name of the advanced battlefield surveillance system launched by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in January 2025 to boost the Indian Army’s reconnaissance capabilities?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**SANJAY.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched the advanced Battlefield Surveillance System (BSS) named SANJAY to enhance the Indian Army’s reconnaissance capabilities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• SANJAY is an automated system designed to integrate data from ground and aerial sensors to provide real-time battlefield transparency.
 
• It enables centralized decision-making through the Army Data Network and Satellite Communication Network.
 
• The system improves Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) operations, ensuring better situational awareness and security.
 
• It has been developed indigenously in collaboration with Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) under the ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’ initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About SANJAY:**__

 __
 
• The system will monitor vast land borders and prevent intrusions with its cutting-edge sensors and state-of-the-art analytics.
 
• It will be deployed in three phases from March to October 2025 across Brigades, Divisions, and Corps of the Indian Army.
 
 
 
• **Budget and Development:**__
 
 
• Developed under the ‘Buy (Indian)’ category at a cost of ₹2,402 crore.
 
• Aligned with the declaration of 2025 as the ‘Year of Technology Absorption’ by the Indian Army.

questions.question: Who was honored with the Vayu Sena Medal for his role in rescuing the hijacked ship Ruen from Somali pirates, where he piloted a C-17 aircraft on a high-risk 10-hour mission to ensure a precision airdrop of marine commandos in the Arabian Sea?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Wing Commander Akshay Saxena**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Wing Commander Akshay Saxena** of the Indian Air Force (IAF) was awarded the **Vayu Sena Medal** for his bravery in a high-risk **anti-piracy operation** to rescue the **Bulgarian-operated bulker Ruen** from Somali pirates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• On **December 14, 2023**, Somali pirates hijacked the Ruen about **380 nautical miles east of Socotra Island**, taking **17 crew members hostage** and sailing the vessel toward the Somali coast.
 
• Instead of anchoring near Somalia, the pirates decided to sail further, intending to use the Ruen as a **"mother ship"** for further piracy.
 
• Saxena was **Captain of the C-17 aircraft** involved in the operation, which supported **Op Sankalp** aimed at anti-piracy operations in the Arabian Sea.
 
• The operation was **highly risky**, involving a potential threat from **small arms fire** from the pirates and flying undetected in another country's airspace for nearly **four hours**.
 
• Saxena made the decision to **turn off all emitters** and fly at **low altitude** to avoid detection, successfully guiding the crew to a **precision airdrop** that led to the **capture of the pirates** and the **rescue of the ship and crew**.
 
• The mission required effective **inter-service coordination** with the Indian Navy and heightened **situational awareness** in both the air and on the ground.
 
• On **March 15, 2024**, an Indian Navy long-range patrol intercepted the hijacked vessel about **260 nautical miles east of Somalia**.
 
• The **Indian warships INS Kolkata** and **INS Subhadra** were positioned alongside the hijacked vessel. The pirates **opened fire** on the warships, **shooting down a drone** from INS Kolkata.
 
• A team of **18 marine commandos (Marcos)** was deployed, and **Saxena piloted the C-17** for a **precision airdrop mission** to insert the commandos near the Ruen.
 
• The mission's successful execution displayed Saxena's **exceptional courage**, **dynamic leadership**, and **steadfast determination**.

questions.question: What is one of the key principles recently outlined by India to boost economic ties with the European Union?

options.text: Develop resilient supply chains and secure critical raw materials.
Increase reliance on non-market economies for raw materials.
Expand trade by focusing on low-cost production methods.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Develop resilient supply chains and secure critical raw materials.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal outlined a six-point plan to enhance economic ties with the European Union (EU) during a meeting with Maros Sefcovic, European Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security, on January 18-19, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India and the EU agreed on mutual collaboration to build resilient supply chains and secure critical raw materials.**
 
• India aims to harmonize standards with the EU for "zero defect" and "zero effect" production capabilities.
 
• A roadmap for addressing tariff and non-tariff barriers was laid to benefit businesses, farmers, and fishermen on both sides.
 
• Both parties plan to expedite the establishment of a robust Free Trade Agreement (FTA) to address global challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Six-Point Plan Highlights__

 __
 
• Strengthen a fair and equitable trade agenda by addressing tariff and non-tariff barriers.
 
• Promote sustainable development while considering levels of development and shared responsibility.
 
• Enhance technology exchanges to build cutting-edge solutions and foster economic collaboration.
 
 
 
• India-EU Trade and Technology Council (TTC)__
 __
 
• A platform for dialogue on trade, investment, and technology cooperation between India and the EU.
 
• Focuses on reducing dependencies on non-market economies and improving global competitiveness.
 
 
 
• India-EU Relations__
 
 
• India and the EU together represent a market worth over $24 trillion and a population of approximately 2 billion people.
 
• The collaboration aligns with shared democratic values, the rule of law, and aspirations for economic growth.

questions.question: What is the name of the portal inaugurated by Union Home Minister Amit Shah to connect Indian agencies with INTERPOL's network?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**BHARATPOL.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the BHARATPOL portal developed by the CBI in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The BHARATPOL portal connects Indian law enforcement agencies to INTERPOL's network of 195 countries.**
 
• It facilitates international collaboration for crime control, including tracking fugitives, drug trafficking, and human trafficking.
 
• The portal provides real-time access to 19 INTERPOL databases, ensuring faster and more efficient investigations.
 
• Features like 'Trial in Absentia' simplify the prosecution of fugitive criminals in their absence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **INTERPOL:**__ The International Criminal Police Organization facilitates worldwide police cooperation. It provides tools like Red Corner Notices to track criminals globally.
 
• __**CBI:**__ The Central Bureau of Investigation acts as India's National Central Bureau for INTERPOL, coordinating international criminal investigations.
 
• __**Trial in Absentia:**__ A legal provision allowing the prosecution of fugitive criminals in their absence, ensuring justice is served while respecting due process.
 
• __**Aatmanirbhar Bharat:**__ A government initiative aimed at making India self-reliant across sectors, including defense and law enforcement.

questions.question: Which country is hosting the 1st International Pashmina Festival to promote "Chyangra Pashmina"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Nepal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **First-ever International Pashmina Festival** was held in **Kathmandu**, organized by the **Nepal Pashmina Industries Association** and the **Confederation of Nepalese Industries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The event highlighted the unique **Chyangra Pashmina**, a delicate, lightweight, and warm natural fiber obtained from the undercoat of **Pashmina goats**.
 
• Nepal is a leading producer of **authentic Pashmina**, often branded as **Chyangra Pashmina**, which is **government-certified** for its quality and originality.
 
• The production process involves **hand-combing** the wool from Pashmina goats during their natural shedding season, followed by **hand-spinning** into fine threads and weaving on **traditional handlooms**.
 
• The festival featured **over 150 stalls**, with more than **40 stalls showcasing pure Nepali Pashmina**, running until **January 25**.
 
• **Minister for Industry, Commerce, and Supplies** Damodar Bhandari emphasized that Nepali Pashmina has made a name for itself internationally, competing with **China** and **Mongolia**, and is in demand in countries like **America**, **Japan**, and **Europe**.
 
• Challenges highlighted included ensuring the supply of **raw materials** to meet market demands and improving **policies** to support the industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandra Dhakal**, President of the **Federation of Nepalese Chambers of Commerce and Industry**, called for greater **collaboration** between the government and the private sector to enhance the market for Nepali products both domestically and abroad.
 
• In **India**, Pashmina products are primarily created in **Ladakh**, **Jammu**, and **Kashmir**, with machine-woven versions produced in **Amritsar**, gaining worldwide popularity for their **softness**, **warmth**, and **intricate designs**.

questions.question: Which IIT inaugurated Asia's largest Shallow Wave Basin to advance research in ports, waterways, and coastal engineering?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Madras**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IIT Madras launched Asia's largest Shallow Wave Basin Research Facility** at its Thaiyur campus, 36 km from the main IIT Madras campus.
 
• The facility is **indigenously developed** under the **National Technology Centre for Ports, Waterways, and Coasts (NTCPWC)**, showcasing India's advancement in **coastal and marine engineering**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• It features a **multi-directional shallow wave basin** that enables analysis of **complex wave-current interactions**, critical for **ports, waterways, and coastal challenges**.
 
• Professor K. Murali highlighted that the facility eliminates the need for **external technological dependence** for wave generation and positions **IIT Madras on the global map** for research and industrial applications.
 
• Professor V. Sriram emphasized that the basin was developed as part of the **‘Make in India’ initiative**, with most components **designed, architected, and fabricated in-house**, ensuring sustainability and efficiency.
 
• Applications include testing **3D wave effects on structures**, studying **sediment transport, wave impact loading, and structural stability** under climate change conditions.
 
• The facility’s **modular wave makers and mobile mechanisms** support **multiple simultaneous projects**, making it versatile for both research and industrial needs.
 
• Professor Torsten Schlurmann of Leibniz University Hannover, a collaborator, acknowledged the facility’s **global significance**, enhancing IIT Madras’s position in **marine science and engineering**.

questions.question: What was the name of the indigenously developed docking system used by ISRO to successfully dock satellites SDX01 and SDX02?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Bhartiya Docking System**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **ISRO sucecssfully completed the Space Docking Experiment (SpaDeX)** on January 16, 2025, marking a historic achievement for India.
 
• **India becomes the 4th country** after Russia, the USA, and China to successfully dock satellites in space.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The docking occurred in a **475-kilometer orbit above Earth**, using two Indian satellites, SDX01 (Chaser) and SDX02 (Target).
 
• The **indigenously developed Bhartiya Docking System** was used for this complex maneuver.
 
• The process involved a **precise maneuvering** of the satellites, with the spacecraft moving from **15 meters to a 3-meter hold point** before docking.
 
• The docking was initiated **with great precision**, followed by a **successful spacecraft capture**, and the docking was followed by retraction and rigidization for stability.
 
• The **satellites moved towards each other at 10 millimeters per second**, completing the docking process successfully.
 
• The SpaDeX mission was launched on **December 30, 2024**, using a **PSLV rocket**, and the process was cautiously trialed over several days.
 
• On **January 12, 2025**, a trial attempt brought the satellites as close as 3 meters in a move described as an "exciting handshake" by ISRO.

questions.question: India became an observer state in which international programme focused on intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Eurodrone**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India has officially joined the Eurodrone program** as an observer nation, announced by the **Organisation for Joint Armament Cooperation (OCCAR)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **OCCAR** oversees prominent European defense projects such as the **A400M Atlas airlifter**, **Boxer armored utility vehicle**, and **Tiger attack helicopter**.
 
• The **observer nation Letter of Approval** was delivered to the Indian Embassy in Berlin on **January 21, 2025** by **Joachim Sucker**, the OCCAR-Executive Administration Director.
 
• India becomes the **second Asia-Pacific country** (after Japan) to gain observer status in the Eurodrone program, which was initiated in **2016**.
 
• India’s participation grants it **access to technical data** and the ability to **order aircraft**, but it will not participate in **decision-making** regarding the **design**, **development**, or **workshare** allocation.
 
• **India’s involvement aligns** with its broader defense strategy, particularly following a **joint defense cooperation agreement with Germany** signed in **October 2024**, focusing on **technology collaboration**, **co-production**, and **co-development**.
 
• The **Eurodrone program**, valued at **€7 billion** ($7.3 billion), aims to reduce European reliance on non-European drone systems like the **US MQ-9B**.
 
• Despite **major industry partners** like **Airbus**, **Dassault**, and **Leonardo**, the program has faced **delays** and **cost escalations**, with the first prototype flight scheduled for **2027**.
 
• India’s entry into the Eurodrone program signals **deeper defense ties** with **European nations**, as India seeks to modernize its airpower amidst challenges.
 
• The **Indian Air Force (IAF)** is struggling with a **shortage of squadrons** (only 31 squadrons against a required 42), and the development of the **AMCA fifth-generation fighter aircraft** has faced **setbacks**.
 
• The **MRFA contract**, aimed at acquiring **126 multi-role fighters**, is also still pending, exacerbating concerns over India’s air force modernization.

questions.question: Which space agency successfully germinated black-eyed pea seeds in space under the CROPS-1 mission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **ISRO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **ISRO** has successfully germinated **black-eyed pea seeds** in space as part of its **CROPS** (Compact Research Module for Orbital Plant Studies) initiative, marking a significant step in **space agriculture**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **CROPS project** aims to explore plant growth in space by simulating Earth-like conditions, excluding gravity, to address the **nutritional needs** and **psychological well-being** of astronauts during long-duration missions.
 
• **Challenges in space agriculture** include difficulty in root growth due to microgravity, water distribution issues, high radiation levels, extreme temperature fluctuations, and the need for adequate light for photosynthesis.
 
• **CROPS-1** utilized methods like **hydroponics** (delivering nutrients via liquid solutions), **aeroponics** (using mist), and **soil-like media** to facilitate plant growth in space. The mini greenhouse used **porous clay pellets** as a soil substitute, controlling temperature, light cycles, and moisture levels.
 
• **Germination Process:** Water was injected into the soil medium, triggering germination. By day four, sprouting occurred, and by day five, two leaves had emerged, marking successful seedling growth.
 
• **Future Prospects:** The next phase of CROPS will focus on extending growth periods beyond the initial two-leaf stage, utilizing advanced control systems for **environmental factors** to ensure **sustainable plant growth** in space.
 
• **Ideal Space Plants:** Fast-growing, nutrient-rich plants like **lettuce, spinach**, and **beans** are ideal, along with **root vegetables** and **grains** like **wheat and rice** for long-term sustenance.
